subtitle: Lesson 11 · Unsupervised Learning in Finance

steps.label: Hundreds of returns, few real drivers
steps.sub: most assets move together to some degree

steps.label: PCA finds variance-maximizing directions
steps.sub: no assumption about what the factors are

steps.label: Standardize returns first
steps.sub: otherwise high-vol names dominate the components

code:
scaler = StandardScaler()
returns_std = scaler.fit_transform(returns.dropna())

pca = PCA(n_components=10, random_state=0)
factor_scores = pca.fit_transform(returns_std)

print(pca.explained_variance_ratio_[:5])
# array([0.41, 0.07, 0.04, 0.03, 0.02])
caption: PC1 alone often explains 30-50%+ of variance in a broad equity panel -- the informal "market factor."
